cohort: Infants above 35 weeks of gestation without resuscitation needs or respiratory distress
finding: Pulmonary regional oxygen saturation (rSO2) rapidly increases in the minutes after birth in late preterm and term infants without respiratory distress, reaching a plateau around 9 minutes.
mod_finding: Pulmonary NIRS values were significantly higher for babies born by C-Section compared to babies born by vaginal delivery.
